textoCompleto:
Nursing Calculators, Practice Exams, and Clinical Scales

Complete platform with nursing calculators, clinical scales, medication dosage calculation, and public exam practice tests. Ideal for students, technicians, and nurses looking to optimize daily practice, enhance patient safety, and prepare for exams.

Technology and knowledge for more efficient, competent, and sustainable nursing.
Clinical tools, protocols, schedules, and educational content for students, nurses, managers, and healthcare institutions—with digital responsibility and measurable impact.

Global Reach
Translated into more than 18 languages, covering more than 140 countries.

Clinical Scales
Over 60 automated clinical and care scales.

Calculators
More than 15 clinical calculators to solve routine professional calculations.

Practice Tests
Interactive practice exams from major test administrators, organized by topic with time limits and score tracking.

Library
A collection currently under development to serve as an exclusive resource for nursing literature.

Teaching
Commitment to education through the development of exclusive literary content.

Responsibility
Citation of sources and use of bibliographic references to guide the scope and content.
